candidate.selection: deterministic equal-cardinality matched swaps from the frozen x1 selection, accepting only x3-rank improvements with non-increasing predicted incremental step load
candidate.tie_order: incoming ascending x3 rank; outgoing descending x3 rank; then ascending content signature; uncertain pairs retain x1

hypothesis: Within the existing x1 Fast eligibility and safety envelope, three efficiency buckets per octave can identify equal-size, no-more-expensive group swaps that improve realized Fast quality while preserving every x1 model count and all non-Fast decisions.
no_sweep_rule: Evaluate this x3 candidate once. Do not evaluate another bucket count, threshold, model, feature, head, allowlist, family rule, or Dev-derived exception.
